title: Helping a neighbour with her new phone
instructionsHu: Az idős angol szomszédod új okostelefont kapott, és segítséget kér tőled. Tudd meg, mire szeretné használni, magyarázd el, hogyan tud videóhívást indítani, és beszéljétek meg a további segítséget. Minden pontot teljesíts.

situation.context: Your elderly neighbour, Mrs Brown, is an Englishwoman who lives in your block of flats in Budapest. Her son, who lives in Canada, has sent her a new smartphone, but she has never used one before. She knocks on your door and asks for help.
situation.candidateRole: You are her helpful teenage neighbour.
situation.examinerRole: The examiner is Mrs Brown, your elderly neighbour.
goals: Find out what she wants to use the phone for.
Explain in simple steps how she can make a video call to her son.
Recommend one useful app and say why it is good.
Arrange a time when you can practise together again.
situation.examinerOpening: Oh, hello, dear. I'm sorry to bother you, but my son has sent me this new phone, and I have no idea how to use it.

followUpQuestions: Most of all, I'd like to see my son and my grandchildren in Toronto. Can I do that with this thing?
Oh dear, there are so many buttons. What else could this phone be useful for?
You're very kind. Could you show me again some other time?

usefulPhrases.en: What would you like to use it for?

usefulPhrases.hu: Először koppintson erre a zöld ikonra.
Aztán válassza ki a fia nevét.

usefulPhrases.en: Don't worry, it's easier than it looks.
usefulPhrases.hu: Ne aggódjon, könnyebb, mint amilyennek látszik.
Ez az alkalmazás azért hasznos, mert ...

usefulPhrases.en: Shall I come round on Thursday afternoon?
